test_title: PYST 142: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 31 Jan, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circle facing towards the centre. D is sitting third to the right of A and immediately left of G. Only B is sitting between G and E. C is sitting to the immediate left of F. Who is sitting second to the left of G?
solution:
**Given :** Seven friends A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circle facing towards the centre.

**Explanation **: 

1) D is sitting third to the right of A and immediately left of G.

2) Only B is sitting between G and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d7ed0136ee4313dd63d731d82753a26e5167760a9e6734af9a0f075c8867cee.png] 

3) C is sitting to the immediate left of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f6f71dbad177d95118a6b900c42e3e28c9ea1825cbe1dc833048944c148107b.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement F is sitting second to the left of G.

Hence, **"F"** is the correct answer.
